about_short_description.short_description: Science Exchange provides life sciences procurement and supplier management SaaS solutions.

product.name: Science Exchange Platform
product.description: A life sciences R&D supplier-orchestration platform for sourcing, contracting, compliance, project management, payments, and spend analytics across external research relationships.

product.name: R&D Marketplace and Supplier Network
product.description: A marketplace connecting pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and other research organizations with pre-qualified scientific service providers and consumables suppliers.

product.name: Virtual Lab Manager™
product.description: A managed procurement and lab-operations service that handles purchasing coordination, supplier interactions, order tracking, and related administrative work for biotech teams.

product.name: Preclinical R&D Solutions
product.description: Supplier sourcing and workflow management for preclinical discovery and development programs, including scientific services and research consumables.

product.name: Clinical Research Solutions
product.description: A supplier-management solution for coordinating clinical research vendors, sites, documentation, approvals, payments, and compliance across clinical programs.

product.name: HEOR & Real-World Evidence Solutions
product.description: A supplier-management solution for standardizing health economics, outcomes research, and real-world evidence vendor workflows, spending, and project coordination.
